Physical BLE transport acceptance for audit 1903

Every case is not_run until a named operator attaches the observations below.
Generation does not scan, connect, request permissions, change pairing, start
PowerShell/WinRT, reset a radio or operate a peripheral. The physical supervisor
is a separate explicit command. Reserve exact host @HOST@ on @PLATFORM@ and
peripheral serial @SERIAL@. Do not use a robot with active actuators or a shared
production board. This procedure performs no provisioning writes or credential
reads. Its GATT status subscription changes only that connection's notification
state. The only physical mutation is the separately authorized power interruption
of the reserved peripheral.

Scope and unsupported paths

Linux uses actual BlueZ GATT; macOS uses actual CoreBluetooth GATT and its native
callbacks. The physical probe establishes public device identity, subscribes to
Wendy Lite's existing provisioning-status characteristic without sending any
provisioning command, waits quietly, then observes two outstanding notifications
being released by the physical disconnect. It reconnects to the same public device
ID after the operator restores power. This does not prove L2CAP/TLS, write requests,
controller tuning, long-range PHY or mesh roaming. Those have separate acceptance.

Windows central/GATT/L2CAP is explicitly unimplemented in ble_windows.go. Do not
mark that transport tested, invent a WinRT GATT implementation or treat the normal
'use a LAN connection instead' refusal as a successful BLE connection. The Windows
case starts the actual production PowerShell 5.1 WinRT advertisement watcher twice,
requires the exact reserved MAC and Lite info service in each fresh watcher, and
joins each owned watcher and both pipe readers before proceeding. It proves real
scan restart/cleanup only. The Mac native offline callback executable covers six
blocked C operations and three notification waiters without a radio; its successful
result is not a substitute for physical CoreBluetooth delivery.

Prepare exact source, host and peripheral

1. Inventory source_commit and firmware_source_commit as full 40-character SHAs;
   probe_binary, cli_binary, firmware_binary, identity_record, build_record,
   authorization_record, permission_record, recovery_record as local nonempty files;
   trial as an independent random 32-character lowercase hexadecimal nonce. host contains
   platform (darwin/linux/windows), identity, owner, os_version, adapter_identity,
   radio_firmware and permission_record description. peripheral contains serial,
   device_id, board_model, owner, power_connection, recovery_record description,
   address and gatt_profile:"wendy-lite-info-and-provisioning-status".

2. Independently bind the printed board/USB serial and firmware digest to its
   public Lite device ID, actual radio address and observed GATT service layout.
   A name, RSSI or OS-cached advertisement alone is not identity. CoreBluetooth uses
   its host-specific peripheral UUID @ADDRESS@; Linux and Windows use the observed
   uppercase MAC. Record privacy-address behavior and stop if it changes. Reserve
   a quiet RF setup and disconnect other clients so the one-connection Lite limit
   cannot interfere. Record the actual adapter hardware/driver/firmware, host OS
   build, source-to-binary build log, firmware provenance and board recovery steps.
   Never dump Keychain, Bluetooth keys, Wi-Fi passwords or enrollment files.

3. Build the probe from the exact reviewed checkout on the intended host. This
   compiles but must not execute any physical test:
     macOS/Linux: go test -c -o OWNED_OUTPUT/gatt-physical.test ./go/internal/shared/ble/central
     Windows: go test -c -o OWNED_OUTPUT/scan-physical.test.exe ./go/internal/shared/ble/scan
   Put that binary's path in probe_binary and retain its hash and build log in the
   inventory. Candidate CLI/firmware hashes identify the release under acceptance;
   the probe runs the candidate transport source directly, not the CLI command
   parser. Confirm its source SHA matches the candidate release before crediting
   the result. The generator hashes the transport and probe sources separately.

4. Generate on the intended host platform in a new private output directory:
     python3 ble-transport-rehearsal.py inventory.json NEW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT
   Keep the checkout and output paths intact: the supervisor verifies every source,
   generated plan/helper and artifact hash before starting. A rebuild, another
   firmware, another host or a changed identity requires a new reviewed inventory.
   No result is inferred from generation. Review all hardware cases as not_run.

5. Before launching, the human must authorize scanning and the one reserved board's
   temporary power loss. On macOS, record the actual terminal/probe signing identity
   and Bluetooth permission state. Only the human may grant a prompted permission;
   do not reset TCC databases, disable SIP or change system privacy policy. Denial
   must terminate with an error and no accepted physical marker. Existing denied
   permission may be recorded without changing it. Do not claim denial tested if
   it was not observed. On Windows, use the actual Windows PowerShell 5.1 required
   by production WinRT projection, not a PowerShell 7 substitute; record OS privacy
   permissions and the signed host/tool provenance. Linux must use the intended
   adapter with existing normal-user BlueZ access; do not run the test as root or
   reconfigure the host bus/radio. Record any missing prerequisite as pending.

macOS/Linux actual disconnect and reconnect

6. Run the exact generated command with a foreground terminal and serial observer.
   The supervisor delegates Unix process ownership to the existing bounded group
   guardian. The selected test is @TEST@. Preserve stdout/stderr and exit status.
   It first reads the real Lite public device-ID characteristic, subscribes to the
   actual status characteristic and requires a quiet one-second timeout. Any
   unexpected notification, identity mismatch, subscription failure or disconnected
   baseline fails. It does not send SSID/password/connect/clear-credentials commands.

7. Wait for PHYSICAL_BLE_WAIT_READY with trial @TRIAL@. Both notification operations
   have begun and remained quiet for one second. Within five seconds the owner
   removes power only from the reserved peripheral, using its recorded connector.
   Record the actual power event and host disconnect callback timestamps. Do not
   disable the host adapter or remove another USB device. Both pending calls must
   return disconnected within fifteen seconds of readiness, not their twenty-second
   notification timeout. The probe joins both before releasing the native handle.
   A quiet timeout, unrelated error, one waiter left alive or process crash fails.

8. Only after PHYSICAL_BLE_DISCONNECTED, restore power to the same peripheral.
   Confirm its serial console identity, firmware and resumed advertisement. Within
   sixty seconds write the exact fresh restore nonce using the generated command
   at the bottom. Never precreate that acknowledgment, reuse another trial or
   acknowledge an unobserved restore. The probe opens a new connection, rediscovers
   services and reads the same public device ID. It must print
   PHYSICAL_BLE_GATT_VERIFIED and exit 0. The completed.nonce file is written only
   after that sequence; its existence alone cannot prove the operator's physical
   identity, authorization or timing records. Retain all of them together.

Windows actual WinRT discovery lifecycle

9. The generated supervisor creates a kill-on-close Windows Job Object, starts
   only the exact probe binary, assigns it to that job, then writes a fresh nonce
   permitting WinRT startup. The Go test cannot launch PowerShell before assignment.
   The helper imports only the reviewed Job class; it performs no Wintun, network,
   driver, route, firewall, registry or privilege operations. A failed assignment,
   interruption or timeout drains this exact job and never kills a process by name.

10. Keep the reserved peripheral advertising. Each of two fresh production WinRT
    watchers has twenty-five seconds to report its exact MAC and Lite info service.
    A cached result from the previous watcher cannot satisfy the second one's empty
    initial map. After Close, the probe requires the actual watcher exit record,
    which production emits only after stdout/stderr readers and cmd.Wait finish.
    Require both PHYSICAL_BLE_WINRT_CYCLE records and PHYSICAL_BLE_WINRT_VERIFIED,
    exit 0 and the exact completed nonce. An empty scan, an unavailable radio, a
    missing service UUID or a surviving owned process fails. This proves scan
    restart; no physical GATT disconnect acceptance exists on Windows.

Cleanup and evidence

11. The Unix guardian bounds the physical probe to 250 seconds; Windows supervises
    its probe for 100 seconds and retains its Job handle until all owned descendants
    drain. A signal, unknown exit, missing completed nonce, changed artifact or
    failed cleanup is a failure, never a passing skip. Keep uncertain evidence and
    do not launch a replacement probe until the owned process tree has drained.
    Restore only the reserved peripheral's original power state and leave host
    adapters, other clients and permissions unchanged unless the owner explicitly
    authorized a permission change. Do not forget/remove bonds or reset devices.

12. Preserve exact hashes/source revisions, host/adapter/peripheral records, actual
    permission outcome, physical event timestamps, every attempt's logs/exit and
    cleanup observations. Only then remove this trial's output and acknowledgment
    files. Do not reuse the plan directory: the supervisor refuses existing nonce
    files. All unperformed OS/radio combinations remain not_run. Unsupported Windows
    GATT/L2CAP, physical writes, pairing, TLS and mesh cases remain separate gaps.
